EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Define Recruitment Status Score Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define normalized schema for ClinicalTrials.gov recruitment statuses (RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN) and a scoring contract including numeric score, categorical label, and human-readable explanation.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Implement Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Implement deterministic mapping from normalized recruitment status to score and label, including safe handling of null, unexpected, or deprecated status values.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via EvaluateCare API Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Integrate recruitment status scoring into EvaluateCare facade response contract so each trial includes score, label, and explanation fields for downstream consumption.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Unit Tests for Recruitment Status Scoring
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests validating score outputs for all supported statuses and edge cases including null, unknown, and mixed-case inputs.

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Integration Test for Recruitment Status Score Flow
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Validate end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion through normalization, scoring, and EvaluateCare facade output to ensure consistency and correctness.
